messages:
sam: heads up — the new sample app is causing confusion on onboarding. it returns `500 Internal Server Error` with body "internal error" for rate-limit and auth failures. users can't tell if they should retry or rotate keys.

maria: ouch. can you paste the response?

sam: sure — example from logs: 
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json

{ "error": "internal error" }
```

sam: happens when quota exceeded too (should be 429) and when signature missing (should be 401). sample app just bubbles the runtime message.

jess: that explains onboarding tickets. SDKs should normalize this into typed exceptions with a stable surface: e.g., `RateLimitError`, `AuthError`, `TransientServerError`. then sample app can show actionable next steps.

ajalejandro: +1. platform currently returns varied status codes from different services (legacy proxies). we need a mapping layer at the edge.

maria: agree. two asks: (1) small short-term fix in sample app to unpack messages and surface retry hints, (2) longer-term mapping plan in runtime.

sam: propose sample fix: map 5xx to `TransientServerError` with `retry_after` if present, map 429 to `RateLimitError` and expose `retry_after`, map auth to `AuthError` and include `www-authenticate` or hint. show this in README.

jess: sample code we can add to JS SDK (pseudo):
```js
function toTypedError(resp) {
  if (resp.status === 401) return new AuthError(resp.body.message || 'auth required');
  if (resp.status === 429) return new RateLimitError(resp.headers['retry-after']);
  if (resp.status >= 500) return new TransientServerError(resp.body.message || 'server error');
  return new ApiError(resp.body.message || 'unknown');
}
```

jess: also add `error.code` stable enum (e.g., `ERR_RATE_LIMIT`, `ERR_AUTH`, `ERR_SERVER`) so sample apps can switch on semantics not text.

maria: good. can we also make error messages less noisy? currently they include large stack dumps from internal services. strip stack traces in public responses, keep internal id for support.

ajalejandro: yes — will add `support_id` header and remove stacks from payloads. internal logs will keep full stack.

sam: shipping that will reduce onboarding friction a lot. also request: add short copy in quickstart: "If you see ERR_RATE_LIMIT, wait retry-after or implement exponential backoff".

jess: can take the sample app PR — will add typed errors and small README note.

maria: i'll file a runtime mapping ticket and loop in infra.

deploy-bot: deploystatus: sample-app branch `fix/error-shape` was built and staged ✅

sam: thanks everyone. can we treat this as required for next SDK minor? customers keep hitting this.

maria: agreed — mark as P1 for devex onboarding epic. :thumbsup:
